verdict.rationale: Data export and portability are a fair question for a SaaS productivity suite, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a bulk data export tool, open-format exports, or an account exit path. The Admin SDK items cover user listing, audit reports and device management, which are adjacent admin features rather than a way to export all of a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
